result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered; the main visible defect is a broken/missing image in the 'Popular right now' section for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, which shows a generic placeholder icon instead of the restaurant photo.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken-image placeholder icon on a grey background instead of the restaurant's hero photo, unlike the other restaurant cards which show food images.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this restaurant, and provide a branded fallback image or skeleton state so a broken-image icon is never shown to users.
